source.title: Hackerin: So hat sie den Millionenbetrug illegaler Casinos aufgedeckt
source.note: Interview with the Casino Secrets publisher. Summaries paraphrase what is said; they are claims, not findings of this project.

mentions.claim: Platin Casino was built up in Frankfurt by Thomas Daniel Kalman, later moved with its staff to Malta and the casino to Curaçao.
The Curaçao company is said to belong pro forma to a straw person living in Georgia, run with a local trust office in a set-up linked to SoftSwiss, while the brand Platincasino stayed with Kalman.
The publisher estimates the German tax loss since 2023 at roughly EUR 250 million.
